description: Worked example only. Pit scouting for one team at the session's event.

questions.label: Team number
questions.prompt: Which team's pit did you visit?
questions.guidance: Positive FRC team number of the pit visited.

questions.label: Drivetrain
questions.prompt: What drivetrain does the robot use?
questions.guidance: swerve, tank or mecanum. other for any other drivetrain.

questions.label: Can climb
questions.guidance: true if the team says the robot can climb, false if it cannot. null if not discussed.

questions.label: Climb levels
questions.prompt: Which levels can it climb to?
questions.guidance: Every level the team says the robot can reach.

questions.label: Weight (kg)
questions.prompt: How much does the robot weigh in kilograms?
questions.guidance: Robot weight in kilograms, with decimals if given. Convert only explicit units.
